name: La Torre de Esteban Hambrán (Spain)
description: A hoist half of red and yellow bars within a chequered border bearing a white tower, the fly quartered red with a white crescent and white with blue wavy stripes.
history: Municipal flag of La Torre de Esteban Hambrán; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: bars of the hoist half and the upper fly quarter
chequered border of blue and yellow around the hoist half
crescent on the red upper fly
three wavy stripes on the white lower fly
door and windows of the tower
